newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel declines, premiums steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel declines, premiums steady.

text.p: European jet fuel prices declined in line with futures on Wednesday with premiums unchanged in NWE despite supply tightness, traders said.
Nov IPE futures were $5.50 down at $217.75 on the bearish implciations of API distillate stock data.
Prompt jet remained scarce with NWE refiners continuing to put into diesel but barrels were available for later November.

Jet fuel cargoes cif NWE were unchanged at Nov IPE +$30/30.50 for early November. In the Med early November was unchanged at fob Med high +$5/6. Barges for first half November were around Nov +$33. -- London newsroom, +44 171 542 7646
